responsibility: Implements frontend diagnostic formatting helpers for Go, expanding GCC-style diagnostic extensions such as `%m`, `%q`, `%<`, and `%>` into final strings and forwarding errors, warnings, fatal errors, notes, and debug messages to backend-provided reporting hooks. It also caches backend quote characters and provides the formatting bridge that lets the frontend consistently issue location-based diagnostics without depending on backend formatting internals.
same_name_distinction: Implements frontend diagnostic message processing by expanding Go/GCC-specific format extensions, caching quote characters, and forwarding fully formatted messages to backend hooks. Unlike go-diagnostics.h, this file contains the formatting and dispatch code rather than just the diagnostic API declarations and required backend interface.
